payload.question: What should 'run one now' start? `plumb evaluate` can only run its two built-in tasks (tic-tac-toe or the expense tracker) in a scratch repository. A session dashboard is a new feature for plumb itself, so it would go through plumb's own intent loop: clarify, judge, records, plan, a Sonnet workflow builds it, then proof.
